text:
Maria Chen: Quick micro-game — drop your best two-word lifehack or one-liner. Winner gets a virtual high-five :raised_hands:
Omar Patel: 'Turn notifications off' :white_check_mark:
Lee: 'Plants need comms' :seedling: (I'm serious)
Jin Park: 'Charge in pocket' — never leave your desk with <10%
Sara V: 'Eat dessert' — solves many problems
Omar Patel: also `sudo make coffee` :coffee:
Lee: 'Reply later' — my calendar says yes
Maria Chen: love these. Vote with a reaction — :trophy: for winner, :thumbsup: for runner-up
Sara V: :trophy: on 'Eat dessert' (I stand by it)
Jin Park: :thumbsup: on 'Charge in pocket'
Dev Bot: Reminder: Free snacks in kitchen until 3pm. First-come-first-serve.
Maria Chen: okay dessert wins by emoji consensus. virtual high-five inbound @Sara V :raised_hands:
Omar Patel: honorable mention to `sudo make coffee` — instant mood boost
Lee: can we make this a recurring thing? 'Two-word Tuesdays' :calendar:
Maria Chen: yes. next week's theme: two-word work hacks vs two-word chill hacks. Low-pressure, high-laughs :grin:
